required_changes: Freeze per-path regular-file metadata and an abstract hardlink-group manifest in addition to bytes; never publish device or inode numbers as portable identity.

Classify Git and its helpers as activation-only runtime. Enumerate every alias under the two frozen roots, require group membership count equal to observed st_nlink, hash through O_NOFOLLOW descriptors with stable before/after identity, and cease Git use before returning the activation receipt.
Require sole-link custody for every material Python, Node, library and repository/input file used after activation; any unexpected non-Git hardlink remains a veto.
Bind the canonical custody-manifest hash and activation-only-runtime-complete bit into a new receipt schema; independently recheck them at every material worker gate.

Add negative tests for a hidden alias, removed alias, same bytes on a different inode, relinked bytes, mutation during hashing, unexpected material hardlink, changed group link count and activation-only Git use after receipt.
Create a fresh plan, complete freeze, distinct preread and unique marker only after code and tests pass. The failed marker and invocation must never be reused or retried.
